lines.text: Many learners say: I will call you after one hour.
Better: I will call you in one hour.
Use in for a time from now.
In! The bus comes in five minutes.

data.wrong: I will call you after one hour.
data.right: I will call you in one hour.
data.why: Use in for a time from now.

native.tip: نقول «بعد ساعة»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول in one hour: “I will call you in one hour.” وليس “I will call you after one hour.”

en.tip: In Arabic we say «بعد ساعة», but in English we say in one hour: “I will call you in one hour.” not “I will call you after one hour.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I will call you after one hour.” 😅 In Arabic we say «بعد ساعة», but in English we say in one hour, so the right sentence is “I will call you in one hour.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
